structure: Part 13 mined three whole end-to-end notification traces from journeys.fit.spec.js › notification journeys end to end, each opened and its full action list read: (1) cattle-air = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-cattle-by-air-identification-unweaned-question-cph-number.zip (259 actions, 0 errors, reference GBN-AG-26-0T6VD7); (2) horse-sea = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-horse-by-sea-temporary-admission.zip (238 actions, 0 errors, reference GBN-AG-26-0UZV93); (3) poultry-rail = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-poultry-by-rail-flock-identification-transit-countries.zip (257 actions, 0 errors, reference GBN-AG-26-0965DB). Refs below say 'trace cattle-air|horse-sea|poultry-rail action N' with N the action number in that trace's actions list. The spec file was read in full to map test steps to pages. Every trace walks: create-notification (notification type live-animals) > origin-of-the-import > what-are-you-importing > reason-for-import > consignment-details > animal-identification-details > additional-animal-details > arrival-details > [transit-countries, poultry-rail only] > transporter > upload-documents > roles-and-addresses (place-of-origin, consignor-or-exporter, consignee, importer, place-of-destination pickers, then cph-number for cattle-air and poultry-rail only) > notification-hub > review-notification > declaration (refused once, then confirmed) > notification-submitted > review-notification?reference=<ref> (the submitted view). Snapshots were taken of the hub, review, declaration (clean and refused), submitted and submitted-view pages in each trace (declaration and its error in cattle-air only, as the three are the same copy), plus the roles-and-addresses page before and after the CPH step, the CPH page, the additional details page (cattle-air, poultry-rail), identification details (cattle-air, poultry-rail), transit countries (poultry-rail) and the reason page selects (horse-sea, poultry-rail). The POST network log of cattle-air and horse-sea was read. Page-by-page detail is owned by parts 1 to 12; this part claims the run order, which pages each species and transport mode gets or skips, the hub, review, declaration and submitted pages as each journey fills them, and cross-species differences only these traces show.
